title: Keep streamed TextDecoder state scoped to one ACP connection
body: A module-global TextDecoder used with decode(..., { stream: true }) retains partial-byte state. Concurrent ACP sessions can interleave that state and corrupt outbound JSON-RPC containing multibyte text.
resolution: Construct the TextDecoder inside startAcp so each connection owns its decoder. TextEncoder remains safe to share because encoding is stateless.

title: Treat session/load notifications as an authoritative transcript replay
body: ACP session/load streams the complete conversation through session/update notifications. Keeping the persisted transcript duplicates assistant content, while always ignoring user_message_chunk drops the restored prompts. session/resume does not necessarily replay and must retain the local transcript.
resolution: Enter replay mode immediately before session/load, clear the local transcript, accept user chunks only during that replay, and leave persisted history intact for session/resume. Clear history when resume/load falls back to a fresh session.

title: Populate agent commands and skills from ACP session updates
body: ACP runtimes can publish their slash commands and skills through available_commands_update. Pi exposes its skills this way, so a shared client does not need agent-specific skill registries.
resolution: Subscribe per session, rebuild the command palette from the latest availableCommands payload, and insert the selected slash command into the composer so the user can supply any required arguments before sending.
